raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 20
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator computed an estimate instead of using the actual 2011 census counts by gender, applying the 21.5% and 29.3% rates to the total population with a 50/50 gender split. These rates pertain to adult populations (not the total population), and Bulgaria’s gender distribution isn’t 50/50. This misuse of denominators and assumptions inflated the result to 287.8 thousand instead of the correct 234.9 thousand required from the census data.
